description: High-Resolution 1-Minute Photovoltaic Power, Temperature and Irradiance Time Series from GEDERlab (UPV) is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Guillermo Escrivá-Escrivá. "The experimental infrastructure of GEDERlab, an energy hub located at the Polytechnic University of Valencia (UPV), was used to develop and validate photovoltaic power prediction models. This environment was specifically designed to integrate, operate, and monitor different renewable energy sources, including solar photovoltaic, wind, hydroelectric, and biomass. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
